context: Tests whether the agent correctly annotates a breaking change using the BREAKING CHANGE footer, writes a body explaining the impact, and uses the right commit type and format.

checklist.name: BREAKING CHANGE footer
checklist.description: The commit footer contains a line starting with 'BREAKING CHANGE:' (exact token, uppercase)

checklist.name: Breaking change description
checklist.description: The BREAKING CHANGE footer line includes a description of what broke and what clients must do (not just 'BREAKING CHANGE:' with no text)

checklist.name: Correct commit type
checklist.description: The commit header uses 'feat' or 'refactor' as the type — NOT 'fix' or 'chore'

checklist.name: Scope in header
checklist.description: The commit header includes a scope in parentheses (e.g. feat(auth): or feat(api):)

checklist.name: Body present
checklist.description: The commit includes a body (text after a blank line following the header) explaining the change

checklist.name: Blank line before body
checklist.description: There is a blank line separating the commit header from the body

checklist.name: Blank line before footer
checklist.description: There is a blank line separating the body (or header if no body) from the BREAKING CHANGE footer

checklist.name: Imperative mood
checklist.description: The commit description uses imperative mood (e.g. 'migrate', 'replace', 'remove') not past tense

checklist.name: No trailing period on header
checklist.description: The commit header line does NOT end with a period

checklist.name: Header 72-char limit
checklist.description: The commit header is at most 72 characters

checklist.name: git-log.txt present
checklist.description: git-log.txt exists in the workspace and contains the commit
